pass_2.locations: Original Jaitin 2014 Supplementary Tables S7–S8 local scg_jaitin-sm.pdf.txt lines 23–67; coauthor-uploaded full original Methods lines 254–324, 326–390
pass_2.finding: Independently compared v1 RT1, RT2, ligation adapter and PCR oligos with v2. The v1 Methods pool first-strand cDNA before Exo I, then pool again before second-strand synthesis and IVT; v2 authors’ protocols.io uses Exo I in individual wells before pooling. These are protocol-specific orders and oligo identities, not a common inherited sequence claim.
